h: The Shabbos Meals Bring Redemption Within Each Soul

p: It is stated in the Gemara (Shabbos 118a):
"Whoever fulfills the three meals on Shabbos
from the birth pangs of Mashiach,
and from the wars of Gog and Magog."
Now this needs to be understood:
how does it apply to each individual soul
to be saved from the birth pangs of Mashiach
and from the war of Gog and Magog,
which will take place only in that one generation?
And it is even more of a wonder,
for the author of the statement was Bar Kappara,
who lived in the days of Rebbi.
before the time of the coming of Mashiach.
So how could they say about their generation
"he is saved from the birth pangs of Mashiach,"
along the lines of what Chazal said
it is as if the Beis HaMikdash was built in his days."
That is, every soul of Yisrael
has the power to build the Mikdash inwardly
according to the measure of his days;
the hindrance comes from the community as a whole,
there is a real building of the Beis HaMikdash
in every soul of Yisrael individually.
And consequently the rectifications as well,
of the birth pangs of Mashiach
and the wars of Gog and Magog,
also exist in the spiritual realm
And one may say regarding this
from the very beginning of Creation,
as is known from the shattering of the vessels
each of which said, "I will reign,"
as is known from the holy sefarim.
And from this sprouted the pride and the honor
"Hashem reigns; He is garbed in grandeur";
for it is from the start of Creation,
this was the essence of the serpent's enticement,
כִּי תַאֲוָה הוּא לָעֵינַיִם (בְּרֵאשִׁית ג, ו)
"for it is a delight to the eyes" (Bereishis 3:6),
and he cast impurity into her (Shabbos 146a).
so that he too would die,
and likewise to all the domestic animals and wild beasts,
is through the three Shabbos meals,
of the three holinesses of the Avos.
נֶגֶד קְדוּשַּׁת יִצְחָק אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
corresponds to the holiness of Yitzchak Avinu, alav hashalom,
"The beginning of wisdom is the fear of Hashem";
one is saved from the birth pangs of Mashiach,
which corresponds to the flaw of jealousy,
which is the dross of Yitzchak's trait,
וְכִי עֵשָׂו שׂוֹנֵא אֶת הַדָּם וְכוּלֵּי
אֶלָּא זֶה דָּמוֹ שֶׁל אָדָם בְּגוּפוֹ וְכוּלֵּי
rather, this is the blood of a person within his body, etc."
That is, he cannot bear the life
of any other creatures besides himself;
and this comes from jealousy and baseless hatred.
And this is the matter of the birth pangs of Mashiach,
"The generation in which ben David comes
there is accusation against the talmidei chachamim";
and prosecutors will rise against them."
That is, because they are jealous of one another.
and about them it is said (Yeshayahu 54:13):
"And great shall be the peace of your children,"
for they increase peace in the world
and are engaged in its building;
they too need refinement in this,
and there is room to accuse them
because of a tinge of baseless hatred,
שֶׁעַל יְדֵי זֶה הָיָה חוּרְבַּן הַבַּיִת
through which the destruction of the Beis HaMikdash came about,
for he is all falsehood,' etc.;
Peace said, 'Let him not be created,
What did HaKadosh Baruch Hu do?
He cast Truth to the ground."
That is, HaKadosh Baruch Hu caused to shine forth
the trait of truth upon the earth,
and through this, as a matter of course,
is only to attain the truth
בֵּית שַׁמַּאי וּבֵית הִלֵּל בְּצָרוֹת וְכוּלֵּי
Beis Shammai and Beis Hillel, about the co-wives, etc.,
to teach you that affection and friendship
there is as a matter of course peace
even between those of differing opinions,
because they all intend one thing.
And this is what is written in the Zohar
"Truth and peace are bound one to the other";
and so it is stated in Sefer HaBahir (siman 50),
and it is also in the Hashmatos of the Zohar
And therefore on Shabbos night we say
"And spread over us the shelter of Your peace,"
for it is the time of the spreading of the shelter of peace.
one is saved from the judgment of Gehinnom,
which is for the flaw of desire,
שֶׁהוּא הַפְּסוֹלֶת שֶׁל אַבְרָהָם אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
which is the dross of Avraham Avinu, alav hashalom:
which is the kelipah of Yishmael.
And the holiness of Avraham Avinu, alav hashalom,
that all of a person's love and longing be
"And you shall love Hashem your God
comes from the yetzer hara of desire,
as they said in the Gemara (Kiddushin 81a):
for all go down into it
on account of hinam (the futile matters)";
which corresponds to the aspect of Yaakov,
one is saved from the war of Gog and Magog,
which is the root of self-exaltation and honor,
as we have heard regarding this,
is from the root gag, roof,
and the letter vav in its middle
and exalts itself more and more each time.
is from the wording of the Tanchuma,
"about Gog, who grows proud in the world and rises";
And this will be the culmination of the war:
of the dross of the two extremes,
then will come the innermost refinement,
and from this refinement one is saved
"I am too small for all the kindnesses, etc."
at the time that more good flows to him,
for all the bounty and the good
בָּא לוֹ רַק מִצַּד הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ
comes to him only from Hashem Yisbarach
and not from his own side.
And this is the trait of Yaakov,

p: Now Yaakov is the middle line,
that runs from end to end,
and he is the choicest of the Avos.
And certainly there are included in him the rectifications
of the two extremes as well,
from the right and from the left.
we say at Minchah of Shabbos:
"You are One and Your Name is One,
and who is like Your people Yisrael,
And this corresponds to the three bonds:
HaKadosh Baruch Hu, the Torah and Yisrael;
וְאוֹרַיְיתָא כּוּלָּא שְׁמֵהּ דְּקוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא
and the Torah is entirely the Name of HaKadosh Baruch Hu.
And there are alluded to in this the rectifications
of the three things mentioned above,
"Who is like Your people Yisrael, one nation"
is for the rectification of the birth pangs of Mashiach,
which come because of baseless hatred;
וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה נַעֲשִׂים אֲגוּדָּה אַחַת
and through this they become one band,
is the rectification for the judgment of Gehinnom,
עַל יְדֵי מִדַּת אַהֲבַת חֶסֶד לְאַבְרָהָם
through the trait of the love of kindness of Avraham,
which was only for Hashem Yisbarach,
for he was drawn in his love
to His Oneness, may He be blessed.
which is entirely the Name of HaKadosh Baruch Hu,
And one may say regarding this
the allusion in the Masorah in this parshah,
is the midpoint of the Torah in words,
is the midpoint of the Torah in letters
And this alludes to what we have said,
נִיתְקַן הַפְּגָם שֶׁל שְׁתֵּי הַקְּצָווֹת גַּם כֵּן
the flaw of the two extremes is also rectified.
הוּא הַכּוֹלֵל שֶׁל הָעֶשְׂרִין וּתְרֵין אַתְוָון
and the letter mem is the middle line,
And one may say that alluding to this,
and concludes with the letter lamed,
which reaches up to the middle letter.
which is the sum of Torah she'b'al peh
for there is nothing in Torah she'b'al peh
that is not alluded to in the Mishnah
And regarding the letter tav, we have heard
that it alludes to Olam HaBa,
which is beyond the grasp of this world.
go only up to three hundred,
there is no grasp at all in this world.
And this letter we will merit in the days of Mashiach,
גַּם כִּי יִתְנוּ בַגּוֹיִם עַתָּה אֲקַבְּצֵם
"Even though they recount among the nations, now I will gather them in";
And as they said in the Midrash
כָּל הַתּוֹרָה שֶׁאָדָם לוֹמֵד בָּעוֹלָם הַזֶּה
"All the Torah that a person learns in this world
הֶבֶל הוּא נֶגֶד תּוֹרָתוֹ שֶׁל מָשִׁיחַ
is vanity compared to the Torah of Mashiach."
is that the letter mem is the middle line,
and through it the two extremes are rectified.
And one may say that this is alluded to by
the middle of the words of the Torah,
the first darosh is at the end of the line,
and the second darash at the head of the line.
And it is said in the context of
and as soon as Aharon answered him,
"And it was good in his eyes";
the flaw of the birth pangs of Mashiach is rectified,
peace and brotherhood are brought about,
וְלָכֵן הוֹדָה מֹשֶׁה רַבֵּינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
And therefore Moshe Rabbeinu, alav hashalom, conceded
And this is alluded to by the middle point
because each one of those who expound
intends to arrive at the truth.
And it alludes to the first mem
at the beginning of the Mishnah;
which is the midpoint of the Torah in letters,
And it corresponds to the refinement of the second extreme,
הַמְרַמֵּז עַל יֵצֶר הָרָע שֶׁל תַּאֲוָה
which alludes to the yetzer hara of desire.
כִּי הוֹלֵךְ עַל גָּחוֹן (וַיִּקְרָא יא, מב)
וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה נִתְקַלֵּל (בְּרֵאשִׁית ג, יד)
and because of this it was cursed (Bereishis 3:14):
that it should have no recovery in this,
but only "and dust shall you eat,"
turn for it into the taste of dust.
for vav is a sign of life,
through which it will have rectification.
And although they said in the Midrash
"In the future all will be healed
'And the serpent — dust shall be its food'"
it will have existence in the future,
רַק שֶׁלֹּא תְּהֵא לוֹ תְּקוּמָה מִנְּפִילָתוֹ
only that it will have no recovery from its fall;
and as the holy Zohar writes
(בְּמִדְרַשׁ הַנֶּעְלָם, זֹהַר חֵלֶק א קלז, א)
it will be called, as it were, Lavan,
and immerses himself from his impurity.
That is, there will not be nullified
הַיֵּצֶר הָרָע שֶׁל תַּאֲוָה מִכֹּל וָכֹל
the yetzer hara of desire entirely;
only that through the vav of "gachon"
it will have existence and refinement,
through which there will be increased
as is stated in the holy Zohar (Zohar I 138a).
